name: steam_on
evidence: steam_init writes 1, steam_shutdown writes 0, the other Steam functions read it. The Linux client names the symbol cs_steam

name: relative_mouse
evidence: reactivategame turns on the relative mouse mode of SDL when it is not zero

name: slow_tick
evidence: checksimulation: the tick interval is 100 ms when it is not zero, 16 ms otherwise. debug_getinputs sets it

name: last_tick_ms
evidence: checksimulation: the SDL time of the last tick

name: tick_start_ms
evidence: checksimulation: the SDL time when the tick started, for the frame time ring

name: view_player
evidence: checksimulation and gameloop: the index of the player whose eyes the camera uses, -1 for none. First field of the record that the Linux client names view

name: voice_on
evidence: checksimulation: F1 toggles it (the = key when the debug flag is on). loadsaveoptions saves it

name: hide_hud
evidence: checksimulation: F4 toggles it. gameloop draws the display only when it is 0

name: mic_gain_percent
evidence: checksimulation: Page Up and Page Down change it by 10, from 30 to 250. gameloop prints it as Mic

name: mic_text_timer
evidence: checksimulation sets it to 4.0 when the gain changes and counts it down. gameloop uses it as the alpha of the Mic text

name: paused
evidence: checksimulation: the simulation does not run while it is not zero

name: step_once
evidence: checksimulation: runs one tick while paused, then clears. debug_getinputs sets it

name: game_state
evidence: checksimulation: the simulation functions run in the states 0, 1 and 2. Same place as Game.state

name: game_tick
evidence: checksimulation counts it in a hosted game; a client reads it as the tick of the server. The traffic lights use its low 11 bits, and the smoothing of humans and objects reads it

name: sim_ticks
evidence: checksimulation: counts every simulated tick. First word of the area sector record

name: last_health
evidence: checksimulation: the health of the viewed human in the last tick

name: damage_flash
evidence: checksimulation: set to 1.0 when the health drops, then it fades by 1/16 for each tick

name: death_fade
evidence: checksimulation: grows by 1/240 for each tick while the viewed human is dead and the state is 2

name: light_angle_a
evidence: checksimulation: the first angle of the light. Gametype 4 sets it from the clock. The [ and ] keys change it when the debug flag is on

name: light_angle_b
evidence: checksimulation: the second angle of the light. Shift with [ and ] changes it when the debug flag is on

name: keyboard
evidence: checksimulation: one byte for each SDL key, not zero while the key is down. The Linux client names the symbol keyboard

name: prevkeyboard
evidence: checksimulation: the keyboard bytes of the last tick. The Linux client names the symbol prevkeyboard

name: frame_time_index
evidence: checksimulation: the next entry of frame_times, 0 to 31

name: frame_times
evidence: checksimulation: the milliseconds that each of the last 32 ticks took

name: frame_time_average
evidence: checksimulation: the mean of frame_times

name: debug_extra_count
evidence: checksimulation clears it each tick. A debug array that renderframe reads

name: chatmessage
evidence: checksimulation counts down the timer of each message. createmessage and frame_drawmessages use them. Records of 0x98 bytes

name: last_event
evidence: clientsend sends its low 16 bits to the server. eventsimulation and resetgame also use it

name: input_wheel
evidence: clientsend sends it as a signed 8 bit value. getinputs writes it and drawhud reads it

name: server_address
evidence: clientsend: the address of the server that the packets go to. joinmenu and connectmenu write it

name: server_port
evidence: clientsend: the port of the server that the packets go to. joinmenu and connectmenu write it
